title: Same-Day Austin Print Delivery from Getcho
summary: But did you know Getcho has made owning a printer in Austin virtually unnecessary?.
body_markdown:
You may know you can use Getcho[to instantly send things to people](https://getcho.app/blog/on-demand-delivery/) -- like food, documents, supplies, tools etc. And you might know[you can use Getcho to pick up your curbside orders from virtually any brick-and-mortar](https://getcho.app/blog/support-local-business/) -- like[Nordstrom](https://getcho.app/delivery-for/retailers/) ,[REI](https://getcho.app/delivery-for/retailers/) , and[The Home Depot](https://getcho.app/delivery-for/retailers/) to name a few. You might even know that[you can use Getcho to grab your takeout food orders](https://getcho.app/blog/supporting-local-restaurants/) .


But did you know Getcho has made owning a printer in Austin virtually unnecessary?


## Print Delivery


With our Print Delivery program, you can emailsupport@getcho.app a PDF document with the subject **TO PRINT BLACK AND WHITE** or **TO PRINT COLOR** . We'll reply with an order number and a price-to-print. And then you can use the[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/getcho/id1460402210) or[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gtcho) Getcho app to dispatch a delivery for right then, or schedule for a more convenient time.


*Note: for the pick-up address, type & select "the Texas Capitol building".*


### Pricing


We'll print at[Fedex](https://www.fedex.com/apps/printonline) ,[The Austin Central Library](https://library.austintexas.gov/) , or whoever has the lowest rate. Then we'll tack that exact amount onto your delivery bill (with a receipt!). Printing tends to be around 14 cents per page black & white, or 55 cents per page in color. Delivery tends to be between $8 and $15 depending on where you are, but the app will give you an exact quote before you order!


Anything else you'd like to see us move? Let us know atsupport@getcho.app . We look forward to serving you!
